retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait of a group in black leather attire surrounded by reaching fan hands, featuring heavy geometric block typography.
excludeWhen: requesting a dark or moody background
requesting a single solo artist without a crowd element

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast composition featuring four young men in black leather and denim standing against a pure white background, with numerous hands reaching up from the bottom edge toward them, topped by massive, interlocking geometric display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered against a stark white void
Reaching hands creating a chaotic frame at the bottom
Heavy, blocky typography anchored to the top third
Monochromatic clothing contrasting with skin tones and white space
coreInvariants: Black leather or dark urban apparel
Multiple hands reaching from the bottom edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group portrait centered, occupying the middle 50% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central two figures and the large black block lettering at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down to the group's faces, and finally to the reaching hands at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the subjects and separating the text from the group.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (secondary text and graphic bars)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with high contrast black elements; low saturation except for the red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers integrated into the wordmark with identical stroke weight to letters
Vertical rectangular bars used as punctuation or framing elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy black geometric display paired with a smaller, lowercase red sans-serif for color contrast.
graphicDevices: Vertical red rectangular bar on the right side

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, geometric feel of the era
Provides the necessary square-off geometric structure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of four young men in black leather jackets and denim standing against a pure white background. From the bottom of the frame, dozens of diverse hands reach upward toward the men. High-key lighting, sharp focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-wide geometric block lettering in black at the top center. Below it, add a secondary line of text in bold lowercase sans-serif in deep red. Include a vertical red rectangular bar on the far right of the text block.

verificationChecks: Are there reaching hands at the bottom edge?
Is the top text extremely wide and blocky?
Is the subtitle text red and lowercase?

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast between black clothing and white background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hands do not overlap the faces of the main subjects.
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Check that the red accent color is consistent across all graphic elements.
Confirm the leather texture is visible and high-contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio group + reaching crowd hands + ultra-wide geometric header.
